name: List All Owners
description: Returns all owners that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters
queryFilters.description: Filters for owners. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] (if available), or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

responseFields.name: data
responseFields.description: Array of owner objects

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of an owner within an owner group

responseFields.name: data[].CompanyName
responseFields.description: The company name associated with the owner

responseFields.name: data[].CustomFields
responseFields.description: The custom fields for the associated entity

responseFields.name: data[].Email
responseFields.description: The primary email address of the owner

responseFields.name: data[].Emails
responseFields.description: The owner's emails

responseFields.name: data[].EmailEcheckReceipt
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not to send a notification to the payee after an eCheck payment is made.

responseFields.name: data[].HoldPayments
responseFields.description: When true, bills created for the owner through the Pay Owner or Owner Draw function will not be available in the Pay Bills flow.

responseFields.name: data[].FirstName
responseFields.description: The first name of the owner

responseFields.name: data[].HiddenAt
responseFields.description: When the owner was marked inactive by an AppFolio Property Manager user

responseFields.name: data[].IsCompany
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not the owner identifies as a company

responseFields.name: data[].LastName
responseFields.description: The last name of the owner

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the owner was last updated

responseFields.name: data[].Link
responseFields.description: A link to the owner's page in the AppFolio Property Manager

responseFields.name: data[].MaintenanceNotes
responseFields.description: Maintenance notes for the properties owned

responseFields.name: data[].PhoneNumber
responseFields.description: The owner's primary phone number

responseFields.name: data[].PhoneNumbers
responseFields.description: The owner's phone number(s)

responseFields.name: data[].Address1
responseFields.description: The primary street address of the owner

responseFields.name: data[].Address2
responseFields.description: Additional street address information pertaining to the owner

responseFields.name: data[].City
responseFields.description: The city where the owner is located

responseFields.name: data[].State
responseFields.description: The state where the owner is located

responseFields.name: data[].Zip
responseFields.description: The zip code where the owner is located

responseFields.name: data[].CountryCode
responseFields.description: The country code of the owner (e.g. US for United states)

responseFields.name: data[].Tags
responseFields.description: User-defined tag(s) that categorize the owner

responseFields.name: data[].UseAlternatePayee
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not the owner payments are submitted to an alternate person other than what is listed for Owner First, Last and/or Company Name

responseFields.name: data[].AlternatePayeeName
responseFields.description: The name of the alternate payee

responseFields.name: data[].AlternatePaymentAddress1
responseFields.description: The street address of the Alternate Payee

responseFields.name: data[].AlternatePaymentAddress2
responseFields.description: Additional street address information pertaining to the alternate payee

responseFields.name: data[].AlternatePaymentCity
responseFields.description: The city where the alternate payee is located

responseFields.name: data[].AlternatePaymentState
responseFields.description: The state where the alternate payee is located

responseFields.name: data[].AlternatePaymentPostalCode
responseFields.description: The zip code where the alternate payee is located

responseFields.name: data[].AlternatePaymentCountryCode
responseFields.description: The country code of the alternate payee (e.g. US for United states)

responseFields.name: data[].Addresses
responseFields.description: The owner's address(es)

responseFields.name: data[].Send1099
responseFields.description: Indicates whether a 1099 form is sent to the owner.

responseFields.name: data[].OwnerConsentedToReceiveElectronic1099
responseFields.description: Indicates whether the owner has consented to receive the 1099 tax form electronically. If Send1099 is false, this value will also be false.

responseFields.name: data[].Sending1099Preference
responseFields.description: Indicates the owner's 1099 sending preference. Valid values include "Paper", "Electronic", "PaperAndElectronic", or "null". If Send1099 is false, this value will be null.

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
